description.zh: 待重置的集群管理系统用户名，如果HBase实例没有新建用户，默认用户名为**root**。
description.en: The username of the cluster management system to be reset. If no user has been created for the HBase instance, the default username is **root**.

description.zh: 集群管理系统目标用户名的新密码。长度为2~30位，需包含大写字母、小写字母、特殊字符和数字中的一种或者多种，允许的特殊字符包括_-。
description.en: The new password for the target username of the cluster management system. The password must be 2 to 30 characters in length and must contain one or more of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, special characters, and digits. Supported special characters are underscores (_) and hyphens (-).
The ID of the target instance. You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~144595~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase modify-ui-account-password --cluster-id ld-bp150tns0sjxs0000 --account-name test01 --account-password 0000000000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
